query: Is there an official Indian government website where I can file a workplace sexual harassment complaint online?
answer: [Official Online Complaint Portal - How to File a Workplace Sexual Harassment Complaint Online (SHe-Box)]: SHe-Box (Sexual Harassment electronic Box) is an official Government of India online portal maintained by the Ministry of Women and Child Development. Women working in both public and private sector organizations can register workplace sexual harassment complaints online, which are routed to the relevant Internal Committee or Local Committee for action and status tracking. [Section 11 - Inquiry Timeline and Procedure]: The Internal Committee or Local Committee must complete its inquiry into a sexual harassment complaint within a period of 90 days. Both parties must be given an opportunity of being heard during the inquiry.
